summary: A mixed legal and business day, led by Delhi High Court staying a JNU disciplinary fine and ordering a Red Notice for court allegations, alongside FMCG distributors formally petitioning the PM on UPI merchant discount rates and Reliance Jio beginning IPO investor meetings.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court stays JNU order imposing fine on students for smiling at protesters.
Delhi HC orders CBI to issue Red Notice via Interpol for man making allegations against Indian courts.
FMCG distributors write to PM seeking zero-MDR on UPI transactions, citing cascading tax incidence.
Reliance Jio begins investor meetings for IPO listing alongside NSE's planned share offering.
Fujifilm to invest Rs 800 crore in semiconductor materials plant at Dholera Special Investment Region via Tata Electronics pact.
